text:
sanjay: Quick broadcast — seeing spike in 503/timeouts from embeddings API in eu-west starting ~2026-03-23T12:10Z. Initial signals look like a transient network partition between compute pods and the network-attached storage fabric. Status: investigating. Live status: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1811112222

elena: Alerting notes: streaming embed jobs (batching=true) most impacted. Tail latency >10s causing client timeouts. Non-streaming single-embed calls less affected.

kevin-sre: Observed net-io drops on fabric switches + flapping connections on storage gateway nodes gw-eu-4 and gw-eu-5. Packet drops correlating with 2xx -> 503 transition for readers. Pulling pod logs now.

ops-bot: Recent logs:
```
2026-03-23T12:12:03Z WARN  network gw-eu-4 ifdown  %LINK-3-UPDOWN: Interface Gi1/0/2, changed state to down
2026-03-23T12:12:04Z ERROR embeddings api handler.go:218 id=req-9a2 client=acme-corp downstream=503
2026-03-23T12:12:06Z WARN  storage io latency=12500ms path=/mnt/embeds shard=12
```

sanjay: Immediate mitigations applied:
- Bumped embeddings API replicas in eu-west by +40% to reduce per-pod load (manual scale)
- Disabled large-streaming paths (batch window > 250ms) via runtime flag to force small batches
- Rerouted high-priority customers to eu-central via read-replica routing (CS notified)
- Evacuated two flaky storage gateways and replaced with healthy nodes
Observed: errors for streaming endpoints down from ~22% -> ~9% in last 8m.

michelle: CS update: created #cs-embeds-eu2 for customer comms. Reached out to top 4 impacted accounts; offered immediate routing to eu-central and the temporary smaller-batch client workaround. Tracking case IDs in shared sheet.

kevin-sre: Next steps I'm running now:
1) replace remaining gateway node gw-eu-6 (in progress, ETA 15m)
2) validate network fabric routes and clear mc-agg caches
3) if instability persists, we will fail traffic to eu-central for all embeddings (planned safe-failover).

deploy-bot: Note: all non-critical deploys to eu-west suspended for 90m.

anna-cs: Customer note template (pasted):
```
Hi <customer>, we're investigating transient errors for embeddings in eu-west. We can route your traffic to eu-central immediately or suggest reducing batch_size to 16 as a temporary workaround. Contact cs@redwood.ai to opt in.
```

sanjay: Severity set to Sev2. Incident bridge: https://call.redwood.ai/bridge/1811112222 (ops on bridge). Postmortem owner requested — please claim in #postmortems. I'm taking lead for now.

elena: I'll post a follow-up after gateway replacement completes or earlier if we see regression. For now monitor: dashboards.embeddings.eu-west and alerts (threshold: 5xx_rate > 3%).

michelle: If stabilized in next 30m I'll prepare an exec one-liner and update the status page. :white_check_mark:
